response.text: {"messages":[{"role":"customer","text":"hey morning!"},{"role":"business","text":"morning! what can we get started for you?"},{"role":"customer","text":"ok so me n my partner r figuring this out lol. gonna start w 2 drip coffees"},{"role":"business","text":"got it, 2 drip coffees. anything else?"},{"role":"customer","text":"ya one hot chocolate medium w hazelnut and almond milk instead of whole milk pls"},{"role":"business","text":"medium hot choc, hazelnut, almond milk sub. noted"},{"role":"customer","text":"also 2 americanos medium. and quick q - do the bagel sandwiches come on any bagel or just plain?"},{"role":"business","text":"you can pick any bagel we have - plain, everything, sesame, or cinnamon raisin"},{"role":"customer","text":"cool thx. then 1 breakfast sandwich on a bagel no cheddar"},{"role":"business","text":"breakfast sandwich on a bagel, no cheddar. and?"},{"role":"customer","text":"and a croissant w butter pls. thats it. we'll pick it up, payin cash. name's dev"},{"role":"business","text":"perfect dev - 2 drip coffees, 1 medium hot chocolate w hazelnut and almond milk, 2 medium americanos, 1 breakfast sandwich on a bagel no cheddar, 1 croissant w butter. see you soon!"},{"role":"customer","text":"yep thats everything thx!"}]}
